title: MCP & Integration Modernization
brief: Standard .mcp.json, full tool annotations, resource optimization. Currently MCP config embedded in settings.json, not standard .mcp.json format. Tool annotations exist but not all dispatchers classified. MCP resources, prompts, completions partially implemented but not fully wired.

phases.title: MCP Standards & Integration
phases.description: Migrate to standard .mcp.json, expand tool annotations to all dispatchers, wire MCP resources and prompts, configure deferred tool loading, add health monitoring, wire resource links into output, and create distribution bundle.

units.title: Create standard .mcp.json
units.rationale: Standard .mcp.json at project root is the official MCP discovery mechanism. Moving config from settings.json enables portable project setup and multi-project MCP configurations.
entry_conditions: Current MCP config exists in settings.json
exit_conditions: MCP loads from .mcp.json at project root
settings.json MCP entries migrated or removed
.mcp.json follows official schema

steps.instruction: Read current MCP configuration from settings.json mcpServers section.
Create .mcp.json at project root following official MCP config schema with servers, tools, and resources sections.
Migrate all MCP server definitions (serena, playwright, context7) to .mcp.json.
Verify MCP servers load correctly from new config location.

deliverables.description: Standard MCP configuration file at project root

units.description: Create standard .mcp.json — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Tool annotation expansion
units.rationale: Tool annotations (readOnly/destructive/idempotent/openWorld) enable clients to make safety decisions. All 67 dispatchers need complete annotations for full MCP compliance.
features: Complete tool annotations for all 67 dispatchers
exit_conditions: All 67 dispatchers classified with readOnly, destructive, idempotent, openWorld flags
Annotation coverage 100%
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Read existing toolAnnotations.ts, identify unannotated dispatchers.
Classify each unannotated dispatcher by analyzing its actions (read-only queries vs state-changing operations).
Add annotations for all missing dispatchers.
Verify 67/67 dispatchers annotated.

deliverables.description: Complete tool annotations for all dispatchers

units.description: Tool annotation expansion — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: MCP resource templates
units.rationale: MCP resources expose machine/material/tool/alarm data as browsable URI templates, enabling clients to discover and query data without knowing dispatcher action names.
features: MCP URI resource templates for machines, materials, tools, alarms
exit_conditions: Resources browsable via MCP protocol
URI templates: prism://machine/{id}, prism://material/{name}, prism://tool/{catalog}/{id}, prism://alarm/{code}
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Read existing resources.ts to assess current resource template coverage.
Wire machine resource template to machine-profiles-catalog lookup.
Wire material resource template to material database lookup.
Wire tool resource template to ToolCatalogEngine search.
Test each resource URI resolves correctly.

units.description: MCP resource templates — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: MCP prompt catalog
units.rationale: MCP prompts expose the top 10 skills as structured prompt templates, enabling clients to invoke common workflows with pre-filled parameters.
features: Top 10 skills exposed as MCP prompts
exit_conditions: 10 prompts available via MCP
Prompts include: speed-feed, quote, simulate, feasibility, playbook, alarm, tool-select, program-gen, video-replay, fusion-generate
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Read existing prompts.ts to see current 7 prompts.
Add missing prompts: program-gen, video-replay, fusion-generate with appropriate parameter schemas.
Verify all 10 prompts resolve correctly via MCP protocol.

deliverables.description: Complete MCP prompt catalog with 10 prompts

units.description: MCP prompt catalog — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Deferred tool loading config
units.rationale: Not all 67 dispatchers need to be loaded at startup. Configuring ToolSearch for lazy-loading of less-used tools reduces initial context and startup overhead.
features: Deferred tool loading for less-used dispatchers
entry_conditions: Tool annotations complete from P0-U02 to classify usage frequency
exit_conditions: Tool loading optimized: top 20 dispatchers eager, remaining 47 deferred
ToolSearch fetches deferred tools on demand
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Analyze dispatcher usage frequency from hook logs or hardcoded priority list.
Configure top 20 most-used dispatchers as eager-loaded.
Configure remaining 47 as deferred, available via ToolSearch.
Test that deferred tools are discoverable and callable after fetch.

units.description: Deferred tool loading config — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: MCP server health monitoring
units.rationale: MCP servers (Serena, Playwright, Context7) can silently fail. Health monitoring via cron or HTTP hook detects unresponsive servers and alerts before they cause workflow failures.
exit_conditions: Health monitored for all configured MCP servers
Unresponsive servers detected within 5 minutes
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Write mcp-health-check.sh that pings each MCP server endpoint for responsiveness.
Use CronCreate to schedule health checks every 5 minutes or on session start.
Report unresponsive servers to state/CCM-MS8/mcp-health.json.

units.description: MCP server health monitoring — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Resource links in tool output
units.rationale: Resource links (materialLink, machineLink, toolLink) in tool output enable clients to navigate from results to detailed resource views, improving discoverability.
features: Resource links embedded in dispatcher output
exit_conditions: Links in output for material, machine, and tool references
At least 5 dispatchers emit resource links in their responses
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Read resourceLinks.ts to understand current link generation API.
Wire materialLink into calcDispatcher responses that reference materials.
Wire machineLink into camDispatcher and cncOpsDispatcher responses.
Wire toolLink into toolDispatcher and sfDispatcher responses.
Test that output includes clickable resource URIs.

deliverables.description: Resource link integration into dispatcher outputs

units.description: Resource links in tool output — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: MCP bundle manifest
units.rationale: .mcpb distribution manifest enables portable deployment of the entire PRISM MCP server as a single package with all tools, resources, prompts, and completions declared.
exit_conditions: Bundle created at dist/prism.mcpb
Manifest declares all tools, resources, prompts, completions
Bundle is self-contained and portable

steps.instruction: Read existing manifest.json if any from Wave 8 MCP modernization.
Create or update manifest.json with complete tool list (67 dispatchers), resource templates (4), prompts (10), completions (4).
Write build script that packages manifest + server into dist/prism.mcpb.
Test that the bundle can be loaded by an MCP client.
